objects.name: Analytic 2163
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies a Linux process joining Industrial Control System (ICS) multicast groups via socket() with IP_ADD_MEMBERSHIP, from a User Identifier (UID) not associated with any authorized ICS protection system monitoring application. OT operational-fidelity gate: Do not alert on novelty, scan/read volume, or enumeration alone. Alert when the source role is not authorized for discovery/polling and the target scope, address/tag range, protocol, or rate deviates from the established operational baseline. Suppress normal SCADA/HMI/historian polling, commissioning, asset inventory, backup, diagnostics, and approved engineering activity.

x_mitre_log_source_references.name: auditd:SYSCALL
x_mitre_log_source_references.channel: Linux Audit SYSCALL/EXECVE/SOCKADDR records (configured audit rule): socket/connect activity from a process outside the approved ICS monitoring-tool baseline to an ICS multicast destination/group
